meaning: topic marker は (read わ) · "as for X…"
gist: は marks the topic — what the sentence is about — then the rest comments on it: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です. Write は, say わ. Builds on Noun + です/だ.

rows: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です
[私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]だ
[田中|たなか]さんは[先生|せんせい]です
[専攻|せんこう]は[日本語|にほんご]です
formation.note: Particle は is always written は and pronounced わ (not like the mora は in はな). Do not write the particle as わ. も ("also") replaces は — they do not stack (taught in mo-also).

explanation: は sets the topic frame: "as for X, (it/I) am Y." [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です means "As for me, (I) am a student." The noun before は is what you are talking about; です/だ still does the equating. Pronunciation is the key beginner trap: the topic particle looks like は but sounds like わ. Keep register from the previous lesson — polite です by default; だ for plain form; spoken casual often uses a bare noun (私は学生。).

senses.label: Self as topic
senses.body: Name yourself as the topic, then give the identity with です/だ.
senses.example_ruby: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です。
senses.example_en: I am a student. (as for me…)

senses.label: Other people as topic
senses.body: Any person noun (or name + さん for others) can be the topic.
senses.example_ruby: [田中|たなか]さんは[先生|せんせい]です。

senses.label: Role / field as topic
senses.body: Abstract nouns like 専攻 (major) can be the topic too.
senses.example_ruby: [専攻|せんこう]は[日本語|にほんご]です。

register_context: Topic は is register-neutral; politeness still lives in です vs だ. Polite: 私は学生です. Plain form: 私は学生だ. Spoken casual often drops だ: 私は学生。. Dropping は after a clear topic (私学生です) is also common in casual speech — not a hard error, but write は in careful / classroom Japanese. Do not attach さん to your own name: ×私は田中さんです → 私は田中です.

mistakes.wrong_ruby: [私|わたし]わ[学生|がくせい]です。
mistakes.right_ruby: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です。
mistakes.why: The topic particle is written は (read わ). Do not spell the particle as わ.

mistakes.right_ruby: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です。
mistakes.why: は needs a topic noun in front of it.

contrasts.label: は vs も
contrasts.summary: は marks the topic ("as for X"); も means "also/too" and replaces は rather than stacking on it.
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です。
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [私|わたし]も[学生|がくせい]です。
contrasts.ex_b_en: I am a student too. (も replaces は)

contrasts.label: With topic vs bare copula
contrasts.summary: Bare 学生です identifies without naming the topic; 私は学生です frames who you mean.
contrasts.ex_a_en: (I) am a student. (topic left to context)
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です。
contrasts.ex_b_en: As for me, I am a student.

examples.ruby: [私|わたし]は[学生|がくせい]です。
[私|わたし]は[田中|たなか]です。
examples.note: polite · name · no さん on self

examples.ruby: [田中|たなか]さんは[先生|せんせい]です。
examples.english: (Talking about a classmate's teacher) Tanaka-san is a teacher.

examples.ruby: [私|わたし]は[日本人|にほんじん]です。
examples.english: (Nationality in a self-intro) I am Japanese.

examples.ruby: [専攻|せんこう]は[日本語|にほんご]です。
[山田|やまだ]さんは[会社員|かいしゃいん]です。
examples.english: (Office small talk) Yamada-san is an office worker.

examples.ruby: [私|わたし]は[大学生|だいがくせい]だ。
[友達|ともだち]は[医者|いしゃ]です。
examples.english: (Introducing someone) My friend is a doctor.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.ruby: はじめまして。[私|わたし]は[田中|たなか]です。
dialogue.english: Nice to meet you. I'm Tanaka.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.ruby: [私|わたし]は[山田|やまだ]です。よろしくおねがいします。
dialogue.english: I'm Yamada. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.ruby: [学生|がくせい]です。[専攻|せんこう]は[日本語|にほんご]です。
dialogue.english: (I'm) a student. My major is Japanese.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.ruby: [会社員|かいしゃいん]です。よろしくおねがいします。
dialogue.english: (I'm) an office worker. Nice to meet you.

checks.why: Topic marker is written は (read わ). も means "also" (later lesson); spelling the particle as わ is wrong.

checks.prompt: Context: introducing yourself politely — set yourself as the topic. 私（　）会社員です。
checks.why: Framing "as for me" → は. も would mean "I am also an office worker," which needs a prior "also" context.

checks.prompt: How do you pronounce the topic particle in 私は学生です?
checks.why: Topic は is always pronounced わ, even though it is written は.

checks.prompt: Context: "As for Tanaka-san, (he) is a teacher" — not "Tanaka too."
checks.why: Topic frame uses は. も would mean "Tanaka too"; わ is the wrong spelling of the particle.
